elements.requirement: In the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971, the expression "controlled drug" means any substance or product for the time being specified.
elements.quote: the expression “controlled drug” means any substance or product for the time being specified—

elements.requirement: In the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971, the expressions "Class A drug", "Class B drug", and "Class C drug" mean any of the substances and products for the time being specified respectively in Part I, Part II, and Part III of Schedule 2 to the Act.
elements.quote: the expressions “Class A drug”, “Class B drug” and “Class C drug” mean any of the substances and products for the time being specified respectively in Part I, Part II and Part III of that Schedule

elements.requirement: In the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971, the expression "temporary class drug" means any substance or product that is for the time being a controlled drug by virtue of a temporary class drug order.
elements.quote: the expression “temporary class drug” means any substance or product which is for the time being a controlled drug by virtue of a temporary class drug order

elements.requirement: The provisions of Part IV of Schedule 2 have effect with respect to the meanings of expressions used in Schedule 2.
elements.quote: the provisions of Part IV of that Schedule shall have effect with respect to the meanings of expressions used in that Schedule

elements.requirement: Her Majesty may by Order in Council make such amendments to Schedule 2 to the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 as may be requisite for the purpose of adding any substance or product to, or removing any substance or product from, any of Parts I to III of that Schedule.
elements.quote: Her Majesty may by Order in Council make such amendments in Schedule 2 to this Act as may be requisite for the purpose of adding any substance or product to, or removing any substance or product from, any of Parts I to III of that Schedule

elements.requirement: Amendments made to Schedule 2 by Order in Council may include amendments for securing that no substance or product is for the time being specified in a particular one of Parts I to III, or for inserting any substance or product into any of those Parts in which no substance or product is for the time being specified.
elements.quote: including amendments for securing that no substance or product is for the time being specified in a particular one of those Parts or for inserting any substance or product into any of those Parts in which no substance or product is for the time being specified

elements.requirement: An Order in Council under section 2 of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 may amend Part IV of Schedule 2 to the Act, and may do so whether or not it amends any other Part of Schedule 2.
elements.quote: An Order in Council under this section may amend Part IV of Schedule 2 to this Act, and may do so whether or not it amends any other Part of this Schedule

elements.requirement: An Order in Council under section 2 of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 may be varied or revoked by a subsequent Order in Council made under section 2.
elements.quote: An Order in Council under this section may be varied or revoked by a subsequent Order in Council thereunder

elements.requirement: No recommendation shall be made to Her Majesty in Council to make an Order under section 2 of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 unless a draft of the Order has been laid before Parliament and approved by a resolution of each House of Parliament.
elements.quote: No recommendation shall be made to Her Majesty in Council to make an Order under this section unless a draft of the Order has been laid before Parliament and approved by a resolution of each House of Parliament

elements.requirement: The Secretary of State must not lay a draft of an Order under section 2 of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 before Parliament except after consultation with or on the recommendation of the Advisory Council.
elements.quote: the Secretary of State shall not lay a draft of such an Order before Parliament except after consultation with or on the recommendation of the Advisory Council
